teaser: A compact introduction that leaves room for your own story, approach and team.
author: administrator
body:
Quanta Portfolio is a flexible starting point for creative businesses. The layout keeps navigation simple, typography strong and project imagery prominent.

Built to become yours

Replace the studio name, adjust the color variables at the top of assets/css/style.css, swap the sample visuals and edit each page from Quanta. No external image service or JavaScript framework is required.

Good portfolio sites make the work easy to understand and the next step easy to take.
title: About the studio
